answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require every agent to publish a build lineage for its kernel: source, recipe and hash are recorded, and independent builders rebuild it to verify the same hash. Weight counts only for a unique, builder-attested lineage. Identical kernels collapse to one weight, just as boats at the same jetty count as one berth, not ten, and a whisper of doubt from any builder triggers a rebuild audit. An attacker must write, maintain and audit a distinct codebase per fake, turning a cheap copy farm into a costly software shop, each fake paying its development and audit bill.
